verdict.rationale: ClickHouse's core design (columnar, MergeTree, incremental materialized views to precompute aggregations) is documented for fast analytical queries, and this is strongly corroborated by independent community reports of real-time aggregation over hundreds of millions/billions of rows at low cost, replacing Elasticsearch/Druid at scale, and use as a single-node BI backend without a separate warehouse (clickhouse-comm-18, -20, -12, -13, -15, -11, clickhouse-docs-9/18/12). Missing for 10: a documented head-to-head dashboard-latency benchmark, and mention of caveats like limited JOIN performance (clickhouse-comm-19) that could affect some aggregation workloads.
